paper.title: Multi-User Contextual Cascading Bandits for Personalized Recommendation

unmapped: Episodic: in each of T episodes, N users (contexts) arrive simultaneously and each is served a session of up to H sequential arm displays (with replacement) from K arms; session ends at the first click (absorbing)
Click probability is logistic sigma([x; onehot(k)]^T theta) with shared parameter in R^{d+K}
Heterogeneous known per-arm click rewards e_k > 0; the learner knows e_k
Regret is against the optimal backward-planning (finite-horizon MDP) policy per context
Parameter updated only at the end of each episode (batch of N users)
settings.definition_quote: In MCCB, the learner operates over $T$ episodes, and in each episode, the learner interacts with \( N \) contexts and selects from a fixed set of $K$ arms. The interaction with each context unfolds over an $H$-step session, during which the learner presents a personalized, ordered slate of up to H candidates (with replacement) from the global arm set $[K]$... We assume that the probability of an absorption is modeled using a logistic function: P(r_{t,n,k} = e_k | x_{t,n}, k) = sigma(z_{t,n,k}^T theta)

symbols.e_max: maximum per-click arm reward max_k e_k
symbols.sigma_hat_min: min_k sigma(z^T theta_hat_t), minimum estimated click probability
symbols.V_Tt: 4 c_z^2/(w_min p_min) * log(1 + w_min p_min T_tilde/(2 lam))
symbols.T_tilde: total number of observations sum_t sum_n h*_{t,n} <= N T H

conditions: (A3) positive margin: every arm is Delta_0-margin optimal with probability >= gamma_0 over contexts
(A4) sigma_min = sigma(-c_z) > sup_{t>T_0} (1/4) beta_t sqrt(z^T A_t^{-1} z)
(A5) warm-start contraction guarantee after T_0 episodes
tuning: regularization lambda (lambda >= c_z^2 used in proof)

source.label: thm:UCBBP

results.notes: Paper claims O~(sqrt((d+K)HNT)) in the contributions, but the explicit bound contains beta^2 sqrt(NT * T_tilde) with T_tilde up to NTH, which does not obviously yield that rate; recorded the explicit statement. sigma_hat_min and p_min are data-/algorithm-dependent quantities. Regret is over T episodes with N users each.

bound.expression_latex: T_0 N e_{\max} + \frac{4\,e_{\max}\,k_{\mu}}{c_{\mu}\,\hat\sigma_{\min}}\, \beta_{\widetilde T}\, \sqrt{\sum_{t=1}^{T} M_t \cdot \mathcal{V}_{\widetilde{T}}} + 2\,\beta_{\widetilde T}\, \sqrt{H \sum_{t=1}^{T} M_t \cdot \mathcal{V}_{\widetilde{T}}} + \frac{4e_{\max} \,c_z}{c_\mu \hat\sigma_{\min} \sqrt{\tfrac12 w_{\min}p_{\min}}} \cdot \sqrt{T} \cdot \beta_{\widetilde T}

symbols.V_Tt: 4 c_z^2/(w_min p_min) * log(1 + w_min p_min T_tilde/(2 lam))
symbols.S_M: sum_{t=1}^T M_t with M_t = max(1, floor(N exp(-t/ln T))); O(N log^2 T)

conditions: (A4) strictly positive absorbing probability with margin
tuning: M_t = max(1, floor(N exp(-t/ln T))) contexts explored by UCB, rest greedy

source.label: thm:AUCBBP

results.notes: Proof concludes Regret = O~(sqrt((d+K)(HN + T))) using sum M_t = O(N log^2 T) and beta = O~(sqrt(d+K)) (the step from beta*sqrt(...) to that rate appears to drop a beta factor). Recorded the explicit theorem expression.
